description: This file defines the MotionService class, which provides motion activity and pedometer data retrieval functionalities using CoreMotion APIs. It implements methods to fetch activities and step counts within a specified date range, handles authorization checks, and formats the data into custom payloads.

classes.name: MotionService
classes.description: A service class that provides methods to retrieve motion activities and pedometer data asynchronously.

methods.name: activities
methods.description: Fetches motion activity data within a specified time range, supporting limits, and formats it into a payload.

methods.name: pedometer
methods.description: Retrieves pedometer data (steps, distance, floors) within a specified time range and returns it as a payload.

methods.name: resolveRange
methods.description: Utility method to resolve start and end dates from ISO8601 strings, defaulting to start of current day and current date.

methods.name: confidenceString
methods.description: Converts CMMotionActivityConfidence enum values to their string representations.
